ValidationRule.description: Close case for Email EMIR Reporting Delegation when Typology and reason are required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), ISPICKVAL(SER_Outbound_Mailbox__c , "Email EMIR Reporting Delegation"), ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Subtype_GM__c )), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case that is Email outbox as "Email EMIR Reporting Delegation" must have the following fields completed: Typology y Reason
